<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Horses">Horses</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Sugar?section=8&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Horses" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Sugar?action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section's source code: Horses"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Sugar can be fed to <a href="/w/Horse" title="Horse">horses</a> to heal 1<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="0.5 hearts"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="💔" src="/images/Half_Heart_%28icon%29.png?cb16e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span></span>, speed growth by 30 seconds, and increase taming probability by 3%. </p>

<ul><li>According to <a href="/w/Minecraft_Education" title="Minecraft Education">Education Edition</a>, the chemical formula of <i>Minecraft</i> sugar is C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub>O<sub>6</sub>; while this could make it <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C6H12O6" class="extiw" title="w:C6H12O6">any number of simple sugars</a>, it confirms it is not actually <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/sucrose" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:sucrose">sucrose</a> (common table sugar).</li></ul>
